item.title: Why top firms fire good workers
item.description:
📝 Workers accept being underpaid temporarily because remaining at a top firm signals their elite status to the market. Churning happens not because these employees have failed but because they may be just somewhat lower-skilled than their peers. Workers accept being underpaid temporarily because remaining at a top firm serves as a signal to the market about their elite status.
🔗 Read more: https://www.rochester.edu/newscenter/employee-turnover-why-top-firms-churn-good-workers-681832/

item.title: Virgin and Qantas to ban use of portable power banks after string of fires
item.description:
📝 From December 1, Virgin Australia passengers will be required to keep power banks within sight and easily accessible throughout the flight. Qantas, QantasLink and Jetstar will all ban the use of power banks from December 15. Power banks are prohibited in checked-in baggage.
🔗 Read more: https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-11-21/airlines-virgin-australia-qantas-ban-power-banks/106033982
